title: Aye saniye zehra ke pisar aun o mohammed
body:
aye saniye zehra ke pisar aun o mohammed
kuch tumko nahi maa ki khabar aun-o-mohd
1. jungle hai andhera hai qayamat ki ghadi hai
bulva-e-sitam mein shab-e-ghurbat ki ghadi hai
phatta hai yeh zainab ka jigar aun-o-mohd
<<MINI>>
aye saniye zehra ke pisar . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
2. tum tapti huwi reti pe yoon khoo mein nahaye
ab kaun sada maa ki sune daud ki aaye
dhonde tumhe maa ran me kidhar aun-o-mohd
3. khaimon mein layin aag lagane chale aaye
ab koi nahi ahle haram ko jo bachaye
uthta hai dhuwa jalte hain ghar aun-o-mohd
<<MINI>>
aye saniye zehra ke pisar . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
4. kehti hain yeh sar peet ke ab zainab-e-muztar
jeeti rahi main dil pe liye daag bahatar
tum kargaye duniya se safar aun-o-mohd
<<MINI>>
aye saniye zehra ke pisar . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. tum hyder-o-zehra ke nigaho ki zia ho aur nusrat-e-haq ke liye rah-e-numa ho
tum din ke ho lal gahar aun-o-mohd
6. tum nusrat-e-shabbir ho waris-e-jaffer
sikhlado phir ek baar shuja-at ke wo johar
hyder ke ho tum noor-e-nazar aun-o-mohd
<<MINI>>
aye saniye zehra ke pisar . . .
